set_text.text: Cost avoidance needs a real ask, such as a supplier letter or a new price list. A rise you expected but were never quoted does not count, so set it to 0%.
Where VOS picks up after a supplier deal
Your sell price is where a saving lands

VOS does not measure savings or deal with your suppliers. It works on the selling side, where each account orders from its own guide at the prices you set. When a deal changes a sell price, you update the guides in the VOS admin platform.
Order guides tied to your own SKUs and prices
Guides and accounts updated in one admin platform
Order history per account, showing who ordered when
Promos and confirmations reach accounts by notification and text
What to run after procurement savings
A saving is one number from one negotiation. These three check the invoice, the delivered cost and the payment terms behind it.
